column1: # agent-tools.tsv (harbor#1010) - the USE WHEN and the exact invocation of every agent-facing `harbor` verb and bin/ tool; bin/skill-catalog.sh renders them into the skill catalog.

# Why a data file: the verb table in bin/harbor and the agent-facing marks in contracts/cli.md say WHAT a thing is; a session arrives with a SITUATION, and that sentence is the only thing it can search by. The catalog is generated from this file and is the one route to a tool no listing announces.

# Coverage is checked both ways (skill-catalog.sh --coverage; lint skill.catalog-covers-tools): every verb in bin/harbor and every script contracts/cli.md marks `**Agent-facing.**` has a row here, and every row names a verb or bin/ script that exists and appears in its own invocation.

# Columns, tab-separated, one header row. kind is verb or tool. name is a verb (or `verb subverb`, e.g. `event ci`) or a bin/ file name. use_when is one sentence, no tab. invocation is the exact command; run bin/ tools from the harbor checkout (~/port/harbor) or your worktree of it. Row order is the table order. Names no client, company or account.

column3: use_when
you need the generated counts, or the obligations ledger (open PRs, approvals, overdue items)
a dependency may be missing and you need to know what breaks without it
you must know whether the security floor is on for this box
you must know whether the installed box works (floor, doctor, shims, roots), read-only
you changed anything in this repo and want the conventions gate before you push
a document or working-context file may be stale
a citation in docs/reference/citations.md may have drifted (needs network)
you want to see what the guards decided, and why a command was blocked
you want the state of the box as a page to open
you changed something that ships to the config dir and need it installed; plan first
you need the security floor installed or reinstalled through deploy
you need the floor removed through deploy
an install broke the config dir and you need the last snapshot back
you added or changed a skill or command and need it installed on the box
you added or changed an injection rule (context-rules/) and need it live
policy/constitution.md changed and the box CLAUDE.md must follow
you need a browser and do not know which backend to use
you must act in the operator's logged-in Chrome (a console, a dashboard behind a sign-in)
column4: harbor chrome attach; harbor chrome detach

column3: you are about to rename or delete a path or an id and need every place that cites it
you need the scripts, tests, checks and docs a family or system owns
you need the layered map of systems, families and components
you need the event bus: emit, wait for, or read events
column4: harbor event tail 20; harbor event emit <kind> <subject>

column3: you are waiting on a PR's CI: use this instead of polling gh pr checks
column4: harbor event ci <owner/repo>#<n> --timeout 1800 (run in the background)

column3: you wait for any other event on the bus (a PR opened, a job done)
you want the live state as a localhost console
you are setting up a fresh machine's PORT_ROOT and private layer
you need to know which identity may reach a system, or register one
column4: harbor access list; harbor access has <id>

column3: a workload repo ships a harbor-pack/ that must be installed box-wide or removed
column4: harbor pack list; harbor pack install <repo-id> --live

column3: several PRs must merge in order, each on its own green CI
opted-in fleet repos must be merged and deployed unattended
you create a new governed repo or adopt a checkout into the registry (scaffold, register, route memory, plan labels)
column4: harbor repo new <name> --kind <repo-kind> --dry-run; harbor repo list; harbor repo audit <name>

column3: you wait on a PR's CI verdict (never poll gh pr checks, gh run watch or gh pr view in a loop)
column4: sh ~/port/harbor/bin/ci-wait.sh <owner/repo>#<n> --timeout 1800 (run in the background; exit 0 green, 1 red, 3 still running)

column3: you wait on an EXTERNAL condition (a port, a cloud build, a data sync) and need a deadline and a diagnosis
you wait on a PR for the first thing that needs you: a review thread, a failed check or green
you must hand a PR over and need the steps to land it, derived from the live repo
you are about to merge a PR and want to know whether it may be merged
you push a branch: verify first, then push in seconds (a plain git push dies with HTTP 401 under load)
you run suites: this carries the idle and hard timeouts and the CPU governor, a suite run by hand has neither
you want to know which suites your changeset must run, and why
you want to know in seconds whether every generated file is current, and the fix for a stale one
pre-push says the protected-paths register is stale
pre-push says .github/CODEOWNERS is stale
pre-push says the vendored naming package differs from the registers
you added or re-described a skill, or registered an agent-facing tool, and the catalog must be regenerated
you name a file, script, env var, rule id or skill and want it judged before you commit
you added a path or an env name and want to know whether it is a new naming finding
you wrote a PR title, body or branch name and want it judged against the git convention
you start a task and need a worktree of your own, or you finish one
you need to know which other sessions are live in this working tree
you need a governed repo's checkout path, or a named root, without guessing it
you need what the notes store already knows about a subject before you start
